findings.evidence: `rg -n "Analysis\.Semigroups\.BoundedGenerator|public import TauCeti\.Analysis\.Semigroups" code/TauCeti` shows `BoundedGenerator.lean` exists and imports its dependencies, while `TauCeti/Analysis/Semigroups.lean:7` only has `public import TauCeti.Analysis.Semigroups.Resolvent`.
findings.fix: Add `public import TauCeti.Analysis.Semigroups.BoundedGenerator` to `TauCeti/Analysis/Semigroups.lean` alongside the existing re-export.
findings.issue: `StronglyContinuousSemigroup.ofBounded` and its API are added in `TauCeti.Analysis.Semigroups.BoundedGenerator`, but `TauCeti.Analysis.Semigroups` still only publicly imports `Resolvent`, so users of the canonical semigroups import cannot see the new construction.

summary: The new bounded-generator material is in the right semigroups area, but it is not re-exported by the semigroups umbrella module, so the advertised API is hidden from the canonical import.
